description: The Socio Data Management © Cross Tab Tool is a professional Power BI custom visual specifically designed for the analysis of scientific, market research and survey data. This visual tool allows you to create sophisticated cross tables with advanced statistical features, customizable formatting and comprehensive significance testing capabilities. Professional cross-tab layouts with up to 2 levels of column hierarchies Statistical significance testing with multiple methodologies Advanced ranking and color-coding options Flexible formatting and display controls Support for single and multi-response data Advanced sorting and filtering of rows and columns Tile display mode
